lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately vertical columns, with inter-column spacing being significantly greater than vertical inter-blob spacing within a single column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with high-intensity circular blobs, where each blob acts as a central node within the vertical band's width.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel horizontal features across the upper lateral flank defined by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity on the superior edge to low-intensity shadow on the inferior edge.
